product.title: Kauai's South & East Small-Group Tour: Legends & Waterfalls

description.text: The Kauai legends, waterfalls, and geysers tour mixes stunning natural sites with storytelling across the island's south and east sides. Take the day off from driving and relax while a local guide shares Hawaiian legends at waterfalls, river lookouts, and the Spouting Horn blowhole. Stops include Wailua River, Opaekaa Falls, Wailua Falls, Tree Tunnel, Spouting Horn. Small-group routing keeps the experience intimate as you travel by air-conditioned vehicle with live narration. Ideal for visitors basing on Kauai who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
